subject.title: Feature: Streaming TTS pipeline for voice calls (sentence-level LLM→TTS→audio)

question: Should classic voice calls gain provider-generic incremental text and telephony audio streaming, and which provider/transport combination should establish the supported partial-playback and fallback semantics?
rationale: This crosses the public speech plugin API, agent output boundaries, carrier playback ordering, and behavior after audio has already reached the caller; those permanent contracts require maintainer intent before implementation.

options.title: Add generic streaming
options.body: Extend only the missing speech contract pieces and land one live-proven provider/transport path while preserving compatible buffered fallback.

options.title: Use realtime only
options.body: Keep the classic STT-to-agent-to-TTS path buffered and designate full-duplex realtime providers as the supported low-latency architecture.

recommendation.title: Add generic streaming
recommendation.body: Extend only the missing speech contract pieces and land one live-proven provider/transport path while preserving compatible buffered fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: The Voice Call restoration, telephony TTS maintenance, and plugin-boundary history make this the strongest available product-routing owner.
